title: Knowledge check: Reactive and Rendering Optimization

questions.prompt: Which approach best matches “Reactive and Rendering Optimization”?
options: Measure a reproducible baseline, profile the constrained resource, and compare the same scenario after a change.
Render every row in a huge list even if only a small window is visible.
Choose an optimization without measuring current behavior.
questions.answer_key: Measure a reproducible baseline, profile the constrained resource, and compare the same scenario after a change.
questions.explanation: This answer addresses Reactive and Rendering Optimization directly. Verify the behavior in a small Vue 3 example and check the runtime requirements in the linked official reference.

questions.prompt: For “Avoiding unnecessary reactive state”, which practice is most reliable?
options: Render all items in a million-row list even when only a few are visible.
Measure a reproducible baseline, optimize the actual bottleneck, then compare the same scenario.
questions.answer_key: Measure a reproducible baseline, optimize the actual bottleneck, then compare the same scenario.
questions.explanation: This practice supports the syllabus subtopic “Avoiding unnecessary reactive state”. Check the expected result and a relevant boundary or failure case.

questions.prompt: A learner example for “Reactive and Rendering Optimization” behaves unexpectedly. What should be checked first?
options: Disable error handling and assume the framework is at fault.
Trust a client-supplied success flag without checking behavior.
Reproduce the state or input change, inspect the relevant Vue binding or dependency, and compare the result with the expected output.
Change unrelated files until the page looks correct.
questions.answer_key: Reproduce the state or input change, inspect the relevant Vue binding or dependency, and compare the result with the expected output.
questions.explanation: Start with a small reproducible case. Inspect the element, reactive source, Console, and expected result before changing unrelated code.

review_note: Answer keys and explanations are server-side data. Human review required before publication.
